task.title: Expose orchestrator worker PR CI and deploy status readback to assistant
task.summary_zh: 讓小幫手可從既有 orchestrator/GitHub 狀態讀回 task、worker、PR、CI、deploy 進度，用於閉環回覆。
acceptance: Assistant can read task owner reviewer blocker next action and task brief path;Assistant can read worker dispatch state without provider credentials;Assistant can report PR CI merge and deploy status when available;Status payloads include source refs and snapshot timestamps;Tests or probe cover unavailable GitHub status degradation
task.next: Closeout complete: implementation PR #914 merged at 6c3640b3f66676a0530c99f9c84db1b9435f5c2c; closeout PR #1015 merged at 55c5b615841117ac939d63abdacfd998d387ecdd; checks passed.
review_notes_zh: Reviewed ASST-INTEG-007 implementation against acceptance: assistant route requires BFF read role, readback is file-based and does not shell out, worker/provider diagnostics pass through assistant redaction, task source refs include snapshot timestamps, and GitHub/CI/deploy metadata is normalized when present in ai-status delivery or github-bus state while unavailable bus data degrades honestly.

Validation: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_github_bus.py services/control-plane/bff/assistant/tests/test_orchestrator_status.py -q (16 passed); python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/bff/assistant/orchestrator_status.py services/control-plane/bff/assistant/models.py; git diff --check for touched ASST-INTEG-007 paths; gh pr view 914 confirmed merged at 6c3640b3f66676a0530c99f9c84db1b9435f5c2c with visible checks success.

Residual non-blocking risk: BFF deployment must provide PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT or equivalent live repo root to read live orchestrator state; otherwise endpoint returns sourceRefs with unavailable/not_found rather than querying GitHub directly.

commit_metadata.Not changing: assistant implementation, supervisor dispatch policy, GitHub bus behavior, provider credentials, deployment controls, frontend code, Codex provider stdin behavior, or MGMT-AI-PERSIST behavior.
commit_metadata.Composes with: merged ASST-INTEG-007 implementation PR #914, closeout PR #1015, and canonical status closeout via scripts/ai-status.sh done.

handoffs.message: Implementation pushed in PR #914; focused pytest, py_compile, and diff check passed. Awaiting Codex review and GitHub checks.

Codex review approved: orchestrator status readback meets ASST-INTEG-007 acceptance; PR #914 merged at 6c3640b3f66676a0530c99f9c84db1b9435f5c2c and focused validation passed. Owner Codex2 should run closeout finalization to done.
